code.lotusscript:
Sub Initialize Dim sess As New NotesSession Dim db As NotesDatabase Dim out As String Dim noteID As String Dim note As NotesDocument Dim title As String Dim flags As String Dim i As Integer Dim j As Integer Dim k As Integer Dim vType As String Dim status As String Dim lvl As String Dim entryType As String Dim colInfo As String Dim selFormula As String Dim aFlags As String Dim forms As String Dim subforms As String Dim pages As String Dim framesets As String Dim outlines As String Dim views As String Dim folders As String Dim agents As String Dim vc As NotesViewColumn Dim v As NotesView Dim vcols As Variant Dim sf As NotesForm Dim sfFields As Variant Dim remForm As NotesForm Dim remFields As Variant Dim acl As NotesACL Dim aclEntry As NotesACLEntry Dim ncForms As NotesNoteCollection Dim ncViews As NotesNoteCollection Dim ncAgents As NotesNoteCollection Dim ncAll As NotesNoteCollection Dim stream As NotesStream Dim exporter As NotesDXLExporter Dim dxl As String Dim chunkSize As Long Dim pos As Long Dim fileNum As Integer Dim fileNum2 As Integer
Set db = sess.CurrentDatabase out = "DATABASE : " & db.Title & Chr(10) out = out & "PATH : " & db.FilePath & Chr(10) out = out & "DATE : " & CStr(Now()) & Chr(10) out = out & String(60, "=") & Chr(10)
'  ' 1. FORM-CLASS NOTES '  Set ncForms = db.CreateNoteCollection(False) ncForms.SelectForms = True Call ncForms.BuildCollection
forms = "" : subforms = "" : pages = "" : framesets = "" : outlines = ""
noteID = ncForms.GetFirstNoteID() Do While noteID <> "" Set note = db.GetDocumentByID(noteID) title = note.GetItemValue("$TITLE")(0) flags = note.GetItemValue("$Flags")(0) If InStr(flags, "r") > 0 Then framesets = framesets & " " & title & Chr(10) ElseIf InStr(flags, "W") > 0 Then pages = pages & " " & title & Chr(10) ElseIf InStr(flags, "U") > 0 Then subforms = subforms & " " & title & Chr(10) ElseIf InStr(flags, "O") > 0 Then outlines = outlines & " " & title & Chr(10) Else forms = forms & " " & title & Chr(10) End If noteID = ncForms.GetNextNoteID(noteID) Loop
out = out & Chr(10) & "=== FRAMESETS ===" & Chr(10) If framesets = "" Then out = out & " (not accessible via SelectForms - FS exists via launch settings)" & Chr(10) Else out = out & framesets out = out & Chr(10) & "=== PAGES ===" & Chr(10) If pages = "" Then out = out & " (none)" & Chr(10) Else out = out & pages out = out & Chr(10) & "=== OUTLINES ===" & Chr(10) If outlines = "" Then out = out & " (none)" & Chr(10) Else out = out & outlines out = out & Chr(10) & "=== SUBFORMS (via $Flags) ===" & Chr(10) If subforms = "" Then out = out & " (none via $Flags)" & Chr(10) Else out = out & subforms out = out & Chr(10) & "=== FORMS ===" & Chr(10) If forms = "" Then out = out & " (none)" & Chr(10) Else out = out & forms
'  ' 2. SUBFORMS via NotesForm API '  out = out & Chr(10) & "=== SUBFORMS (via NotesForm API) ===" & Chr(10) Dim sfNames(0) As String sfNames(0) = "Signature" 'sfNames(1) = "HiddenFields" 'sfNames(2) = "HRUse"
For i = 0 To 0 Set sf = db.GetForm(sfNames(i)) If Not sf Is Nothing Then out = out & " SUBFORM: " & sfNames(i) & Chr(10) sfFields = sf.Fields For j = 0 To UBound(sfFields) out = out & " - " & sfFields(j) & Chr(10) Next j Else out = out & " SUBFORM: " & sfNames(i) & " (not found - may be in template)" & Chr(10) End If Next i
'  ' 3. VIEWS + COLUMN DEFINITIONS '  ' Set ncViews = db.CreateNoteCollection(False) ' ncViews.SelectViews = True ' Call ncViews.BuildCollection ' ' out = out & Chr(10) & "=== VIEWS WITH COLUMNS ===" & Chr(10) ' ' noteID = ncViews.GetFirstNoteID() ' Do While noteID <> "" ' Set note = db.GetDocumentByID(noteID) ' title = note.GetItemValue("$TITLE")(0) ' flags = note.GetItemValue("$Flags")(0) ' If InStr(flags, "F") > 0 Then vType = "FOLDER" Else vType = "VIEW" ' out = out & Chr(10) & " [" & vType & "] " & title & Chr(10) ' ' On Error Resume Next ' Set v = db.GetView(title) ' If Not v Is Nothing Then ' selFormula = v.SelectionFormula ' If selFormula <> "" And UCase(selFormula) <> "SELECT @ALL" Then ' out = out & " Selection : " & selFormula & Chr(10) ' End If ' vcols = v.Columns ' If Not IsNull(vcols) Then ' For k = 0 To UBound(vcols) ' Set vc = vcols(k) ' colInfo = " Col: " & vc.Title ' If vc.IsField Then ' colInfo = colInfo & " [field=" & vc.ItemName & "]" ' ElseIf vc.IsFormula Then ' colInfo = colInfo & " [formula=" & Left(vc.Formula, 80) & "]" ' End If ' If vc.IsSorted Then colInfo = colInfo & " SORTED" ' If vc.IsCategory Then colInfo = colInfo & " CATEGORY" ' out = out & colInfo & Chr(10) ' Next k ' End If ' End If ' On Error GoTo 0 ' ' noteID = ncViews.GetNextNoteID(noteID) ' Loop ' '  ' 4. AGENTS '  Set ncAgents = db.CreateNoteCollection(False) ncAgents.SelectAgents = True Call ncAgents.BuildCollection
out = out & Chr(10) & "=== AGENTS ===" & Chr(10) noteID = ncAgents.GetFirstNoteID() Do While noteID <> "" Set note = db.GetDocumentByID(noteID) title = note.GetItemValue("$TITLE")(0) aFlags = "" On Error Resume Next aFlags = note.GetItemValue("$AssistFlags")(0) On Error GoTo 0 If InStr(aFlags, "E") > 0 Then status = "[ENABLED]" Else status = "[DISABLED]" out = out & " " & title & " " & status & Chr(10) noteID = ncAgents.GetNextNoteID(noteID) Loop
'  ' 5. ACL '  out = out & Chr(10) & "=== ACCESS CONTROL LIST ===" & Chr(10) On Error Resume Next Set acl = db.ACL Set aclEntry = acl.GetFirstEntry() Do While Not aclEntry Is Nothing Select Case aclEntry.Level Case 0 : lvl = "No Access" Case 1 : lvl = "Depositor" Case 2 : lvl = "Reader" Case 3 : lvl = "Author" Case 4 : lvl = "Editor" Case 5 : lvl = "Designer" Case 6 : lvl = "Manager" End Select Select Case aclEntry.UserType Case 0 : entryType = "Unspecified" Case 1 : entryType = "Person" Case 2 : entryType = "Server" Case 3 : entryType = "Mixed Group" Case 4 : entryType = "Person Group" Case 5 : entryType = "Server Group" End Select out = out & " " & aclEntry.Name & " | " & lvl & " | " & entryType & Chr(10) Set aclEntry = acl.GetNextEntry(aclEntry) Loop On Error GoTo 0
'  ' 6. REMINDER FORM FIELDS '  out = out & Chr(10) & "=== REMINDER FORM FIELDS ===" & Chr(10) On Error Resume Next Set remForm = db.GetForm("Reminder") If Not remForm Is Nothing Then remFields = remForm.Fields For j = 0 To UBound(remFields) out = out & " - " & remFields(j) & Chr(10) Next j Else out = out & " (Reminder form not found)" & Chr(10) End If On Error GoTo 0
'  ' Write inventory '  fileNum = FreeFile() Open "D:\Claude\DB_NSF\ESF_all_inventory.txt" For Output As #fileNum Print #fileNum, out Close #fileNum
'  ' 7. FULL DXL EXPORT '  Set ncAll = db.CreateNoteCollection(False) ncAll.SelectForms = True ncAll.SelectViews = True ncAll.SelectAgents = True Call ncAll.BuildCollection
Set stream = sess.CreateStream() Set exporter = sess.CreateDXLExporter(ncAll, stream) exporter.ConvertNotesBitmapsToGIF = False exporter.OutputDOCTYPE = False Call exporter.Process()
stream.Position = 0 dxl = stream.ReadText()
fileNum2 = FreeFile() Open "D:\Claude\DB_NSF\ESF_all_dxl.xml" For Output As #fileNum2 chunkSize = 65536 pos = 1 Do While pos <= Len(dxl) Print #fileNum2, Mid(dxl, pos, chunkSize); pos = pos + chunkSize Loop Close #fileNum2
MsgBox "Done!" End Sub
